headline: 2026 KBO Defensive Awards: all 10 winners on the field
caption:
🧤 2026 KBO Defensive Awards

Guillermo Heredia did it again. The SSG Landers left fielder won his fourth straight KBO Defensive Award, and he's still the only player to win the same position every year since the award started in 2023.

SSG and LG lead the way with three winners each, and LG's Koo Bon-hyeok became the first winner of the new utility award.

P Kwak Bin (Doosan) · C Heo In-seo (Hanwha) · 1B Austin Dean (LG) · 2B Jung Jun-jae (SSG) · 3B Kim Do-yeong (KIA) · SS Park Seong-han (SSG) · LF Guillermo Heredia (SSG) · CF Park Hae-min (LG) · RF Kim Seong-yoon (Samsung) · UT Koo Bon-hyeok (LG)
